evidence.text: The file page identifies 閒-bronze-warring.svg as a modern Inkscape drawing of 閒 in Warring States bronze-script style. It names the source glyph as Xiaoxuetang record 33.EEC1, associated with the late Warring States 兆域圖銅版 (集成 10478), and marks the representation CC0/public domain. This is a redraw, not a photograph of the bronze.
evidence.title: File:閒-bronze-warring.svg

evidence.source: 小學堂字形演變資料庫, Academia Sinica
evidence.text: The official form-evolution database page is accessible, but the browser view exposes only its search interface and not a specific 閒 glyph record. The separate direct query attempts for 間 and 閒 did not open as inspectable records.
evidence.title: 小學堂字形演變

evidence.text: Commons describes 閑-bronze.svg as an ancient-script style digital drawing based on sources including Sinica Database and links it to a Hanziyuan data image. It represents 閑, not 閒/間, so it is not selected for this entry.
evidence.title: File:閑-bronze.svg

search_audit.query: Wikimedia Commons 閒 character bronze inscription 間 glyph file; 小學堂 字形演變 間 閒 字形 資料庫; Wikimedia Commons 間 Chinese character oracle bone bronze glyph
search_audit.outcome: Search located Xiaoxuetang's query interface and a Commons 閒 Warring States bronze-style glyph file. Opened the official database page; it showed the interface but not a glyph record. Opening the Commons result failed with a cache miss.

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 間-bronze 閒 seal script; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 閒 bronze character; 小學堂 閒 字形演變 record query 間
search_audit.outcome: Search results provided Commons provenance and licensing details for a modern 閒 bronze-style redraw, including its cited Xiaoxuetang source record and inscription context. The alternate 閑 file was excluded because it depicts a distinct graph. Direct database query and rights-PDF opens failed.

gaps: No image is proposed: although Commons search results supplied a relevant redraw and provenance, the candidate Commons file page could not be opened in the browser, so an actual direct image URL and independently inspectable reuse terms were not verified. Xiaoxuetang character-specific records and its rights notice also could not be inspected. The Commons result states CC0/public-domain terms, but under this stage's requirements that result alone is insufficient to select an asset.

limitations.text: A search result described 閒-bronze-warring.svg as a modern Inkscape redraw tied to a Xiaoxuetang Warring States bronze-script record (33.EEC1; 兆域圖銅版, late Warring States, 集成 10478), but its file page failed to open. No usable candidate was therefore selected.
